title: Restatement § 90 — first and second formulations
summary: The later formulation broadens the wording of induced reliance and permits a remedy limited as justice requires.
notes: The first formulation at p. 126 requires action or forbearance of a definite and substantial character on the part of the promisee. The second at p. 128 includes the promisee or a third person, omits that phrase, and states that the remedy may be limited as justice requires. Both include a promise, reasonably expected inducement, actual induced conduct, and the requirement that injustice be avoidable only by enforcement. The second adds a charitable-subscription and marriage-settlement provision dispensing with proof of induced conduct. These two reproduced formulations are available in the page reader. The full SEL comments and illustrations are not imported.
